meta.name: marketing-ideas
meta.description: Generate 5 creative, cost-effective marketing ideas with channels, messaging, and engagement rationale. Use when brainstorming marketing campaigns, planning product promotion, or looking for creative marketing tactics.

copy.tagline: 生成5个低成本创意营销方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为产品推广寻找低成本创意营销方案。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need creative, cost-effective marketing tactics for product promotion.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的产品和市场信息，生成 5 个有创意且成本低的营销点子。每个点子包含渠道、核心信息和为什么有效。
howto.when: 当你需要头脑风暴营销活动、规划产品推广或寻找创意营销策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这款新App想5个低成本的营销点子。
say.note: Claude会生成5个营销点子，包含渠道和理由。

say.text: 我们预算有限，怎么推广这个产品？
say.note: Claude会给出成本效益高的营销方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate 5 creative, cost-effective marketing ideas based on your product and market context. Each idea includes channel, core message, and rationale.
howto.when_en: Triggered when brainstorming marketing campaigns, planning product promotion, or seeking creative marketing tactics.

say_en.text: Give me 5 low-cost marketing ideas for this new app.
say_en.note: Claude will generate 5 ideas with channels and rationale.

say_en.text: How can we promote this product on a tight budget?
